notes:
Pre-tick for QuickBooks’ Reconcile window

Fix: matched items are now pre-ticked, not cleared. The Reconcile helper marks them * (pending) in QuickBooks, as Bank Feeds does, so they open already ticked in QuickBooks’ Reconcile window and QuickBooks clears them when you press Reconcile Now. Before, they were set to cleared (✓), which looked as if they had already been reconciled.
One by one or all at once: on the Pre-ticks tab (was Cleared ticks), tick the items and press Pre-tick the ticked ones, or Pre-tick all. Undo works on one item or all of them.
Items already marked * in QuickBooks are not offered again.

Includes everything from 2.0.0-beta.66.
